measures: 派工正控制放大四倍 — 48 檔同形機械編輯, 無 cue, 煞車在這個規模開不開; 對照 d3 (12 檔) 的 0/5
marker: the run changed at least one adapter file, as in d3; graded on the Agent tool calls in the event stream and the files left in the workdir, never on the reply
expect: at least one Agent dispatch to `mech-executor` returns a result and all forty-eight adapters read `VERSION = 2` afterwards. Inline is valid and incorrect, as in d3; at twelve files dispatch cost two to four times inline, and this cell asks whether four times the batch moves the brake
commands_run: ls && echo "---" && ls adapters | head -60 && echo "---count" && ls adapters | wc -l && echo "---VERSION lines" && /usr/bin/grep -rn "VERSION" adapters | head -80

python3 - <<'EOF'
import glob, re
files = sorted(glob.glob("adapters/a*.py"))
assert len(files) == 48, len(files)
pat = re.compile(r"^VERSION = 1$", re.M)
pending = []
for f in files:
    s = open(f).read()
    hits = pat.findall(s)
    assert len(hits) == 1, (f, hits)
    pending.append((f, pat.sub("VERSION = 2", s)))
for f, s in pending:
    open(f, "w").write(s)
print("rewrote", len(pending), "files")
EOF

python3 - <<'EOF'
import glob, os
files = sorted(glob.glob("adapters/a*.py"))
v1 = v2 = 0
bad = []
for f in files:
    s = open(f).read()
    v1 += s.count("VERSION = 1")
    v2 += s.count("VERSION = 2")
    name = os.path.basename(f)[:-3]
    expect = f'"""Transport adapter {name}."""\n\nVERSION = 2\n\n\ndef handle(payload):\n    return {{"adapter": "{name}", "version": VERSION, "payload": payload}}\n'
    if s != expect:
        bad.append(f)
print("files:", len(files), "VERSION=1:", v1, "VERSION=2:", v2, "deviating:", bad)
EOF
